Required VIEW: STRICT LEFT SIDE PROFILE VIEW, the character faces LEFT on the page. Camera rotates exactly 90 degrees around the unchanged T-posed character. Nose and both sneaker toes point to the LEFT edge. Show ONE eye only, one visible ear, a pure profile of nose, chin and hair, and the near left side ivory shorts stripe. No three-quarter view, no visible front chest plane, no rear view.
IMPORTANT 3D POSE PROJECTION: the body remains in the SAME T-pose as image 2; because the camera is now at the left side, the near arm points straight toward the camera and is naturally foreshortened. The near large closed empty fist is seen end-on in front of the near shoulder, at shoulder height; most of its forearm and upper arm are hidden behind that fist. The far arm points straight away and is occluded by the torso. Do NOT lay the arms down alongside the torso, do NOT bend elbows, do NOT spread the arms sideways in the image as if it were still a frontal view. The camera rotates, the skeleton does not. This correct side projection is essential for multi-view reconstruction.
Legs remain slightly apart sideways in world coordinates, so both legs and shoes overlap in the strict orthographic side projection: show a coherent near leg profile, without inventing a walking stride or staggering the feet. Vertical silhouette crown and sole remain at precisely the same heights as image 2: crown y27, soles y977 on a 1536x1024 canvas. Retain generous empty space to the left and right instead of zooming in to fill horizontal width.
assets.view: Strict left-facing profile, near arm foreshortened toward camera, far arm occluded.

review.method: Visual inspection of every image at full displayed resolution; sips confirms all canvases 1536x1024. Existing heads_tall.py run on front and back views.
observed: Front and back have matching T-pose, closed empty fists, clothing color blocks and compact proportions.
Back shows rear hair, neckline, shorts and sneaker heels with orange inserts.
Side faces left with one eye visible and consistent camera-relative T-pose projection, no invented stride.
Complete hair, hands and shoes stay within each canvas; no props or cast floor shadow.
limits: Generated views are approximately aligned, not pixel-registered orthographic renders: rear figure height 946px versus 951px front; profile soles are visually about 20px higher than front.
The front-T-pose head measurement script is not applied to the profile because its algorithm depends on horizontally spread arms.
Individual painted hair and fold facets vary across generated views; a consistent production mesh is not established by this image pack.
Artistic approval and reconstruction validation remain with the subsequent 3D workflow. No paid Meshy task, mesh, rig, or Unity integration performed.
